measurement: Production planner/FIFO/encoder candidate comparison and partial concurrency tuning before final release verification.
interpretation: Default partial ceiling selected as12. CPU efficiency improved in text fixtures with small p95 latency cost; no15percent latency improvement demonstrated. Host/mode-order variation present. Final committed-policy full matrix is recorded separately.
privacy: Synthetic pixels and numeric timing/resource measurements only. No runtime config, screen contents, credentials, or live desktop session.
candidate_note: These runs used exported uncommitted candidate sources; OCI revision labels identify the parent commit, not the full candidate state. Explicit cap12 exercised the same admission path chosen as the final default.
